description.fr: Plugin Claude Code pour développer par agents sans faire exploser la facture : agents routés par rôle, contrôle rapide, mesure du coût réel depuis les transcriptions.
description.en: Claude Code plugin for developing with agents without blowing up the bill: role-routed agents, quick end-of-story check, real cost measurement from local transcripts.

description.fr: Generic dark-first design system: DTCG tokens, theme files (CSS, Python, Streamlit, Office, mermaid) and accessibility checks, as a Claude Code plugin.
description.en: Dark-first design system shipped as a Claude Code plugin: DTCG tokens, theme files for web, Streamlit, Python charts, Office and mermaid, accessibility checks (contrast, colour blindness), and a skill that audits a repository and migrates it to the system.

description.fr: Mods pour l'interface de Claude Code, installables en une ligne
description.en: Mods for the Claude Code interface, installed with one line: diff-replie folds file diffs and shell output into one line and groups consecutive calls of the same kind, keeping the full detail one command away.

description.fr: Démonstrateur pédagogique qui montre, brique par brique, ce qu'un harnais agentique ajoute à un LLM nu (raisonnement, mémoire, outils, RAG, MCP, skills, hooks, sous-agents). Local, sur CPU ; interface en français, anglais et allemand.
description.en: Teaching demonstrator that shows, building block by building block, what an agentic harness adds to a bare LLM (reasoning, memory, tools, RAG, MCP, skills, hooks, sub-agents). Runs locally on CPU; French, English and German interface.

description.fr: Banc de qualité difficile pour petits modèles de langage locaux (Ollama), en français : deux pistes de réflexion, anti-contamination, juge calibré, statistiques appariées.
description.en: Hard quality benchmark for small local language models (Ollama), in French: two reasoning tracks, anti-contamination, calibrated judge, paired statistics.

description.fr: Workbench d'IA locale & responsable : démo de Small Language Models (SLM), RAG avancé et agents autonomes avec mesure d'impact Green IT (CodeCarbon).
description.en: Local and responsible AI workbench: small language model (SLM) demo, advanced RAG and autonomous agents, with Green IT impact measurement (CodeCarbon).

etatLabel.fr: 🟠 En refonte majeure · v1.3.0 · v2.0.0a10 à tester
etatLabel.en: 🟠 Major rework · v1.3.0 · v2.0.0a10 pending manual testing

description.fr: Reporting automatisé et copilote IA d'une usine de migration de SI depuis Jira (données fictives)
description.en: Automated reporting and AI copilot for an IT migration factory driven by Jira (fictitious data).

description.fr: Application pédagogique locale pour apprendre git et GitHub, puis la chaîne CI/CD et DevSecOps, sur du vrai git hors ligne avec un GitHub simulé ; pensée pour les vibe coders. v0.1.0 en test.
description.en: Local teaching app to learn git and GitHub, then the CI/CD chain and DevSecOps, on real offline git with a simulated GitHub; built for vibe coders who need to understand what their agent does to their repository.

description.fr: Having an LLM write every weight of a small neural network directly, without training, compared with hand-written rules, standard training, weight editing and activation steering
description.en: Having an LLM write every weight of a small neural network directly, without training, then comparing it with hand-written rules, standard training, weight editing and activation steering, from rule-based tasks up to grafting written circuits into a small language model.

description.fr: Assistant IA hors ligne pour les consultants en audit de cybersécurité, sur un PC de 16 Go sans GPU : rédaction de fiches de vulnérabilité à partir des notes de pentest par un petit modèle local, sans qu'aucune donnée ne quitte le poste.
description.en: Offline AI assistant for cybersecurity audit consultants on a 16 GB CPU-only laptop: a local small language model drafts vulnerability findings from raw pentest notes, with no data leaving the machine.

description.fr: Roue du hasard : une page HTML autonome pour désigner qui reçoit un cadeau
description.en: Single-file web app (one offline HTML page under 200 KB) that spins a fair wheel to decide who gets a gift: cryptographic draw decided before the animation, accessible, works from file://. Version 1.1 (in development) adds an optional on-device chat to drive the wheel in plain French, through a rules-first cascade backed by small models running locally (decision model and SLM with Ollama); the models only call validated actions and never pick the winner.

description.fr: Assistant IA hors ligne pour les agents du secteur public, sur un PC bureautique de 16 Go : petit modèle fine-tuné, RAG local et serveur MCP officiel de data.gouv.
description.en: Offline AI assistant for French public sector staff on a 16 GB office PC: fine-tuned small model, local RAG and the official data.gouv MCP server.

description.fr: Fixing small language model defects (reasoning loops…) by having an LLM (Claude Opus in Claude Code) edit their weights directly, without training — measured against the original by slm-quality-bench
description.en: Fixing small language model defects such as reasoning loops by having Claude edit their weights directly, without training, then measuring gains and regressions on SLM Quality Bench.

description.fr: Veille outillée sur les agents de code (Claude Code) : plugins, skills et pratiques classés par problème, vérifiés contre la recherche et les praticiens
description.en: Tooled market watch on coding agents (Claude Code first): plugins, skills and practices grouped by the problem they solve, compared with native features and checked against research papers and practitioner feedback, with a visual radar and a sourced report.

description.fr: Banc de comparaison des architectures de recherche documentaire IA (RAG naïf, hybride, GraphRAG, LLM Wiki, recherche agentique…) sur la qualité, le coût, la latence, l'énergie et la conformité.
description.en: Benchmark of AI document retrieval architectures (naive and hybrid RAG, GraphRAG, LLM wiki, agentic search) on quality, cost, latency, energy and compliance.

etatLabel.en: 🟣 Built, training or benchmarking in progress

description.fr: Giving a small language model a "mood" (joy, calm…) by activation steering at inference time — dosable, reversible, no weight change — compared with a role-play prompt on tone, accuracy, sycophancy and energy
description.en: Giving a small language model a "mood" such as joy by activation steering at inference time: dosable and reversible, with no weight change, measured against a role-play prompt on tone, accuracy, sycophancy and energy.

etatLabel.en: 🟣 Built, training or benchmarking in progress

description.fr: Tableau de bord local : suit les projets et les sessions Claude Code menées en parallèle sur plusieurs PC, et indique quoi relancer à la reprise.
description.en: Local, personal dashboard that tracks projects and parallel Claude Code sessions across several PCs: session hooks and a per-PC scan feed a local web app that shows the action to take on each project (stable, to stabilise, paused, to restart, to file) and what to resume after a shutdown.

description.fr: Application pédagogique pour apprendre à évaluer l'IA générative en pratique : pipelines d'évaluation, LLM juges, jeux de données, RAG et fine-tuning
description.en: Teaching app to learn how to evaluate generative AI in practice: evaluation pipelines, LLM-as-a-judge, evaluation datasets, RAG and AI search evaluation, and data and evaluation for LLM fine-tuning.
